# Order summary

Revision: 1
Attempt limit: 3

## Problem statement

Shoppers can't see counts.

## Solution

Show counts.

## User stories

US 1: As a shopper, I want counts, so that I know what I ordered

US 2: As a shopper, I want counts on my phone, so that I can check on the go

## Implementation decisions

- Add a count to the `summary` module.

- A manual check on a phone.
